attributes.name: The Father of Worms
attributes.powers:
The Father of Worms cannot be evaded and is immune to the Acid, Cold, Mental, and Poison traits. When you play a weapon that has the Melee trait against The Father of Worms, bury that weapon.

Before you act, each character at your location attempts a Dexterity or Acrobatics 12 check. Characters who succeed are dealt 1 Cold damage; characters who fail are dealt 1d4 Cold damage and expend 1 mythic charge.
